games.name: Sort Merge - Goods Sorting
games.description:
Sort Merge is a fresh take on classic sorting games, blending relaxing organization with engaging merge mechanics and no-timer gameplay. Your goal is simple: sort and merge goods to complete orders and clear the shelves. With a wide variety of goods and levels, this sorting game is easy to start and fun to play for hours.

Enjoy the pressure-free flow of sorting and the rewarding feeling of every merge. Choose which goods to combine and decide where to place them next, naturally training your focus, logic, and problem-solving skills as you play. Step into a colorful world of shelves and discover the joy of sorting!

How to Play Sort Merge:

Sort items on shelves and merge matching goods to complete orders.
• Tap or drag items to move them across the shelves.
• Sort items so that three identical goods end up on the same shelf.
• Match three identical items to merge them into a higher-level item.
• Each item has three levels—merge items twice to create the final version.
• Final items fill the order boxes at the top.
• If there's no order for a final item, it moves to the deck—don't let the deck fill up with unused goods.
• Use a hint to see what goods are waiting in the next row and plan your moves ahead.
• Complete all orders to clear the shelves and win the level.

Why You'll Love Sort Merge – Goods Sorting:

✔ Relaxing sorting puzzles designed for mindful, satisfying play.
✔ No timers or rush—take your time and enjoy every move.
✔ A fresh mix of matching games, merge puzzles, and classic sort games.
✔ Clever shelf mechanics that make sorting goods easy to learn and fun to master.
✔ Hundreds of varied and unique levels full of colorful goods to organize, with fun twists and a light challenge.
✔ Smooth controls that let you move, swap, and sort items with ease.
✔ Helpful hints that reveal hidden goods in the next row.
✔ A cozy puzzle experience where sorting and merging come together.

Ready to slow down and relax? Play Sort Merge – Goods Sorting. Sort items, merge colorful goods, and enjoy the moment when the shelves finally clear.

games.name: Arrow Rush 3D
games.description:
Imagine a 3D cube covered in arrows. Some point straight ahead. Others twist around corners — stretching across two or even three faces. Your job? Tap each arrow in the right direction to make it fly off the cube. Sounds simple? Wait until they start crossing paths.

🎯 How It Works
Every arrow has a direction — up, down, left, right, or a bendy path that wraps around the cube. You need to tap an arrow so it follows its direction and leaves the cube cleanly. But here’s the catch: arrows must not crash into each other. A wrong tap could send two arrows straight into a collision!

🔄 Inspect Every Angle
The cube is fully rotatable. Drag to spin it, zoom in to see the tricky corners, and study how arrows connect across faces. Some arrows hide their tails on the other side. Only by looking from every angle can you figure out the right order.

🧠 Plan Your Taps
It’s not just about tapping fast. You have to think ahead — which arrow should go first? Which one will block another if you tap too early? The arrows are interlocked like a puzzle knot. Solve the sequence and watch them all fly away.

🧩 More Than Just a Cube
As you progress, the arrows get crazier — longer paths, tighter turns, and more overlapping routes. Each level is a new brain‑teaser that makes you twist your thinking along with the cube.

Ready to twist, tap, and untangle? Grab the cube and let the arrows find their way home! 🔄➡️⬆️⬇️🔲 Click the arrows to make them leave the cube.

games.name: Pyramid Orb Matrix
games.description:
Pyramid Orb Matrix is built around neat colored lines that gradually fill the entire playing field. The player connects dots of the same color by drawing paths between them, trying to avoid intersections. At first, the task seems simple: find a pair and connect them with a line. But very quickly, the free space becomes smaller, and each new line begins to influence all the others.

In Pyramid Orb Matrix, it's important to think through your actions in advance. If you draw a path too early or occupy an inconvenient space, you can accidentally block the opportunity for another color. Therefore, the game gradually turns into a calm puzzle that tests your attention and spatial thinking. You need to see the entire board and find a solution that ensures each line occupies its proper place.

A unique feature of Pyramid Orb Matrix is the automatically generated maps. Each new attempt offers a different arrangement of dots and changes the usual solution process. Sometimes the right path is immediately apparent, while other times you have to mentally rebuild the entire board to fill every cell without errors. It's at these moments that it's especially rewarding to see how the chaotic space gradually becomes a complete pattern.

Pyramid Orb Matrix feels like a logic game with clear and understandable rules. Pyramid Orb Matrix doesn't overload you with unnecessary mechanics and focuses on lines, colors, and open spaces. Pyramid Orb Matrix leaves you wanting to play another map, find a neater solution, and completely fill the board without a single intersection. Connect dots with colored paths without crossing.

Solitaire Dream is easy to learn with simple rules:

Objective – Move all 52 cards (hearts, diamonds, spades, and clubs) to the four Foundation piles.

Crazzy Ludo is the smart offline ludo game where strategy & skill beats luck. Play ludo with friends, family, or AI in classic 2 player, 3 player, and 4 player matches. Save your dice, plan smart moves, and become the king of the board. No internet needed.

🎯 WHY PLAY CRAZZY LUDO?
Most offline ludo games come down to lucky dice rolls. Crazzy Ludo changes that with a unique Dice Saving system. Save your sixes, plan smart captures, and outplay opponents with real skill. This is smart ludo for players who want a true skill board game.

🎲 SAVE DICE, THE STRATEGY EDGE
The save dice mechanic makes Crazzy Ludo unlike any other ludo game. Store great rolls in your dice bank and use them at the perfect moment.

• Save high dice rolls for surprise captures or safe home runs
• Turn weak rolls into winning moves with smart planning
• Combine saved dice for multi-token combos
• Play with or without Dice Saving. Your choice.

This twist turns classic ludo into a real strategy board game. The ludo strategy and dice strategy fans have been waiting for.

🎮 GAME MODES
• Local Multiplayer Ludo: 2 player, 3 player, and 4 player on one device
• Pass and Play Ludo: Take turns with friends and family on a single phone
• Offline AI Mode: Beat smart computer opponents anytime, no internet, no signup
• 2v2 Team Mode: Partner up for coordinated team battles
• Classic Ludo: Pure traditional ludo for purists

🤖 SMART AI THAT CHALLENGES YOU
Three difficulty levels that play like real opponents:
• Beginner: Great for kids learning ludo
• Expert: A balanced ludo multiplayer challenge
• Master: Aggressive AI that uses save dice against you

🔊 CUSTOM CAPTURE AND FINISH SOUNDS
Crazzy Ludo brings a crazy ludo twist to classic play: upload your own audio for the biggest moments. Set a custom sound for token captures. Set another for finishing a token at home. Use the preset library or pick any audio file from your phone. Celebrate every capture with your favorite movie line, song clip, or victory shout.

📶 LUDO WITHOUT INTERNET
Crazzy Ludo is offline ludo you can play anywhere. No internet, no signup, no data charges. Works on flights, long drives, subway commutes, weekend trips, or quiet evenings at home.

🌍 LUDO BY ANY NAME
The classic dice board game goes by many names, and Crazzy Ludo is all of them. In South Asia it is known as ludo, ludo wala game, ludo chakka, chakka, ludo goti, or bina net wala ludo. In Spain and Latin America it is parchís, parchisi, parcheesi, or pachisi. In ancient tradition it is chaupar or chopat. Around the world players also call it lido, lodo, ludu, leedo, and laadhuu. One classic board game, a hundred names.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 PERFECT FOR
• Families wanting an offline ludo game
• Friends gathering for local multiplayer board game fun
• Kids learning strategy, patience, and math
• Ludo and parchisi fans tired of luck-based games
• Travelers and commuters needing a great offline board game

• Need internet? No. Crazzy Ludo is fully offline.
• Need an account? No signup required.
• Can I play 2 player ludo on one phone? Yes. 3 player and 4 player too, with pass and play.
• Can I upload my own sound for captures? Yes. Use the preset library or any audio file.
• What makes Crazzy Ludo unique? Save dice strategy and custom capture and finish sounds.
• Is online multiplayer coming? Yes, in active development.

🚀 COMING SOON
• Online multiplayer to play ludo with friends worldwide
• Global leaderboards and ranked tournaments
• More board themes and customization

📥 PLAY CRAZZY LUDO
The crazy ludo board game where skill beats luck. No signup. No internet. Roll the dice, save your sixes, and become the king of the board. Offline ludo multiplayer game where strategy beats luck. 2-4 player AI & 2v2.

You start with a minimalist grid of gray tiles. Your goal is to click tiles to flip their colors between gray and white until the number of white tiles in every row and column exactly matches the required target numbers.

The challenge lies in the chain reaction constraint: whenever you flip a tile, its adjacent orthogonal neighbors will also flip their states. This creates a halo effect that requires you to plan ahead and see the big picture.

Features:
- Campaign mode with 100 levels spread across 10 chapters.
- Infinite random generation mode with dynamic difficulties from beginner 4x4 boards to expert 8x8 setups.
- Specialized rules such as frozen blocks that cannot be flipped and symmetry constraints.
- Clean, minimalist aesthetic utilizing black, white, and gray tones.
- No network connection required, completely offline gameplay.
- No intrusive permissions. A minimalist logic puzzle. Flip tiles, trigger chain reactions, match targets.

A relaxing one-touch puzzle game. The ball slides forward automatically after you control it.The ball can only move in straight lines: up, down, left, right. No diagonal moves, no turning mid-slide. Collect all coins and travel through all left and right paths to clear the level.
2. How to Play
No tapping, no long press. Swipe the screen in any straight direction. The ball will slide automatically in a straight line. The ball cannot change direction while moving. Wait until the ball stops, then swipe again. Diagonal swipes will not work.
3. Win Conditions (Must complete both)
1. Collect all coins: The ball automatically picks up coins on contact. You cannot leave any coins behind.
2. Pass all left and right passages: Move through every path on the map. Do not skip any roads or avoid any passages.
4. Game Over Rules
You fail the level if the ball slides out of bounds, gets stuck in a dead corner, leaves coins uncollected, or misses any passage. The level will restart automatically.
5. Game Tips
Look at the coin positions and paths first before sliding. Try to collect coins and clear paths in one straight move to avoid extra steps. Swipe gently on narrow roads to stay safe. Always double-check leftover coins and hidden small paths before finishing.
6. Warm Tips
No time limit, no in-app purchases. Play anytime and enjoy a relaxing sliding puzzle experience at your own pace. Slide the ball, collect all coins, clear all paths to win.

games.name: Feather Rush
games.description:
Feather Rush is a tap-to-reveal puzzle grid where chickens stand in for mines. You're working a board of hidden tiles, trying to hit a score target before the timer runs out. Some tiles are empty and worth a small bump. Some hide coins, which jump your score in big chunks. Some hide chickens, and chickens are bad news — they scatter your points and waste your moves. Numbered tiles tell you how many chickens are sitting in the eight cells around them, so you spend a lot of time triangulating: this one says 2, that one says 1, the corner nobody's flipped yet is probably the safe one.

The pressure here is the timer. Classic minesweeper lets you sit and stare at a board for as long as you need. Feather Rush gives you about two minutes per mission and a score floor that grows with each level. Mission 1 asks for 600 points, which is easy enough that the game lets you find your footing. By the time you're a few levels in, you're calculating risk versus reward on every flip — is it worth chasing a number cluster when the clock is burning, or do I just gamble on the next row and hope.

The art softens what's underneath. Bright cartoon palette, blue sky, urban street backdrops, a winking rooster mascot on every mission card. The chickens you discover have little expressions. The coins jingle in. It's cute enough that losing doesn't sting too much, which is probably the point.

The achievement structure pulls you in different directions on the same board. Mine Whisperer wants you to clear the grid clean, no chickens hit. Tactical Mind wants you to flag every chicken correctly before winning. Feather Speed ​​wants the win with thirty seconds still on the clock. So you're not optimizing one variable — you can replay the same mission with a different goal in mind and it genuinely changes how you play it.

The daily bonus is a four-by-four tic-tac-toe pull against the house. You're X, the house is O, three in a row in any line, you take the pot. It's a quick palate cleanser between missions and a reason to come back daily.

Coins from missions feed a stats panel that tracks total score, average score, wins versus losses, and games played. There's an Achievements tab that ledgers the named goals — First Flight, Gold Rush, On Fire, Veteran. The progression isn't aggressive; it just sits there as a quiet record of what you've done. Levels unlock in order, so you can see the road ahead, and you can see what's still locked.

What it feels closest to is minesweeper that learned to be friendly, with a score target and a clock stapled on. The friendliness is real — the visuals don't lie. The underlying puzzle is still honest minesweeper deduction, with all the gambling that implies when the timer is shrinking and you've still got rows of unflipped tiles staring back at you. Chickens hide. Coins shine. The clock ticks anyway.

games.name: Fold Trace
games.description:
FoldTrace is a paper-folding puzzle for people who like to think in space—not swipe through noise. A sheet is folded, punched through the stacked layers, and frozen in place. Your job: tap every cell on the original grid where a hole will appear once the paper is fully unfolded. Submit, watch the stack open in 3D, and see exactly what you got right.

The idea comes from the classic Paper Folding Test used in cognitive research since 1976—here as a calm, premium-feeling game. No hype about “brain scores.” Just a famously studied spatial task, polished for your phone.

CONTENT THAT GOES DEEP
• Easy — 50 curated 4×4 puzzles, one fold. A gentle on-ramp.
• Medium — 1,824 puzzles, two folds. The heart of the journey.
• Hard — 52,464 puzzles, three folds. Territory for players who want to stay a while.
In all, more than 54,000 hand-curated, deterministic levels—no random filler.

A DAILY RITUAL
Every local midnight, the same four puzzles appear for everyone: one easy, two medium, one hard. Clear all four at three stars to earn a +200 perfect-daily bonus toward the global leaderboard. Miss a day? Tomorrow is a fresh sheet.

GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS
Compete on the all-time board or the weekly board that resets every Monday at 00:00 UTC. Pick a display name in Settings—no email, phone, or social login required to play.

CRAFTED TO FEEL QUIET AND PREMIUM
Paper-atelier visuals, a satisfying unfold animation, haptics you can tone down mid-puzzle, and optional audio controls without leaving the board. During gameplay, screen capture is limited so an in-progress daily stays yours. Optional morning reminder at 10:00—only if you want it.

FREE TO PLAY, FAIRLY
You get five lives that refill over time. Optional rewarded ads can help with an extra life or hints. Want every gate lifted and ads removed for good? God Mode and God Mode Plus are one-time unlocks—never a subscription.

Fold the paper. Predict the holes. Unfold the truth—one quiet puzzle at a time.

https://foldtrace.app Relaxing paper-fold puzzles

Merge Fight Fantasy – the idle battle game for fans of the Middle Ages
Fighters come out of crates and can be fused to strong knights in Merge Fight Fantasy.

• Swordsman: close combat – can deal blows as well as take them
• Archer: range combat – can deal blows will, but can not take many
• Dragon: range combat – attacks from the air and by doing so avoids contact with ground troops

There are not only classical fighters, about also special units. Those are Vikings, Samurai, Ninjas, Pirates, Thunder Birds, and many more.
Your knights get further support from the heroes. You can get them through special grates. Heroes also intervene in battles and have special attacks.
Berserkers motivate your fantasy army to strike harder. At the same time, they deal out powerful blows and can hit several opponents with one blow. Paladins protect your knights with their shield, which they also use to deal out blows against several enemies at once.
The last category of fighters are the companions. They also intervene in battles with their special attacks. For example, the Red Panda. It slows down attackers with its cuddle attack and deals out a lot with its roundhouse kick.

Idle, merge, fight
Your colorful Middle Ages army will always gain combat strength as you fuse knights and heroes to make them even more powerful fighters. This way you'll beat one opponent after the other. Additionally, you can take part in Daily Challenges with your knights, gnomes, and heroes. The goal is to win as many battles as possible in a row. For this wave of attacks you'll receive extra rewards and you'll be able to equip your fighters even better.

Are you ready for this idle merge fighting game? Then get Merge Fight Fantasy now! Become the hero of the Middle Ages: fuse gnomes, knights, and other fighters!

Every opponent is a proprietary neural network — 19 nets in all, one per Elo bracket, each trained on millions of real human games. A 1200 rival plays like a 1200. A 2200 rival plays like a 2200.

Bot pacing comes from an XGBoost model trained on 5.6 million Lichess moves. Eleven features per position — eval, ply, time pressure, threats, recaptures. Your opponent doesn't think in metronome ticks. They think the way someone at that level thinks.

Drills are statistical, not random. We extract the exact moments you lost win probability in your own games, then build a replay loop with an Elo-scaled difficulty window. The position you fumbled at 1850 plays back against a 1850 opponent.

All of it runs on your device — no server round-trips, no privacy leak, no monthly bill.

THE 8 CHAMPIONSHIPS

1. The Street (free)
2. The Neighborhood
3. The City
4. The State
5. The National
6. The Continental
7. The World
8. The Interplanetary — the final boss, against Caïssa herself

A FAMILY TRIBUTE

Every championship climbed is a step toward the dream your grandfather never finished. The narrative weaves through the entire app — reminders, milestones, the final boss.

HOW IT WORKS

• Play named rivals at your level
• We detect your biggest mistakes automatically

• Replay the position and hold it to master it

Improvement isn't homework. It's a side effect of playing.

COACHES THAT NOTICE YOUR MISTAKES

Unlock 3 named mentors as you progress — the Library Sage, Master Helena, the Sensei. Each one teaches the patterns YOU are missing.

WHAT YOU GET

NO SUBSCRIPTIONS

One-time purchase. No monthly fees. No tricks.

Buy once. Climb forever. No engines. No cheating. Real opponents at your level — and your mistakes become training. The more you play, the more you evolve. Play more. Improve faster.

games.name: What Am I? Word Party Game
subcategories: Guess the word on your head
games.description:
What Am I? is the guessing game you play with your phone stuck to your forehead. Your friends give you clues, you try to nail the word before time runs out. Tilt down if you got it, tilt up to skip. It's the classic charades-style party game — portable, with thousands of fresh words, and free.

How it works
Pick a category. Phone goes on your forehead, screen facing out. Friends shout hints (no saying the word itself, obviously). When you think you've got it, tilt the phone down. Stuck? Tilt up to skip. Rounds last 90 seconds by default, adjustable in settings.

35+ categories, something for everyone
Animals, food, movies, TV shows, celebrities, music, sports, superheroes, horror, christmas, video games, art, literature, body parts, k-pop, astrology — plus themed sets like magic, far galaxies, fantasy kingdoms, collectible creatures, pixel adventures. If you know the genre, you'll recognize them.

Over 5,000 words in total. Hard to repeat one in the same night.

5 languages
English, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, French. Switch from the in-app menu without restarting. Doubles as casual vocabulary practice in whichever you're learning.

No paywall, no subscriptions
Most categories unlock from the start. Themed ones unlock by watching a short optional ad. No premium tier, no in-app purchases, no nag screens.

Works offline
Once downloaded, you can play anywhere — road trips, the beach, parties with no wifi, your grandma's house.

Made for
Birthdays. Pre-drinks. Family dinners that won't end. Long car rides. Bachelor and bachelorette parties. Holidays. Or any moment five people are in the same room staring silently at their phones. (Fix that.)

Three tips for the best experience
- Get at least three friends. Solo doesn't work — this is a group sport.
- Read the hints out loud, calmly. Don't act them out. That's a different game.
- When someone nails one, celebrate loud. The energy of the room is half the fun.

Download it, slap it on your forehead, and start guessing. Got friends over? Phone on your forehead, tilt to win, laugh till you cry. 5,000+ words, 35+ categories, 5 languages. 100% free. No paywall. Guess the word on your head

games.name: MTG Crafter
games.description:
MTG Crafter is a deck builder app for Magic: The Gathering players. From deck creation and management to solo practice play, all features are delivered through a clean, focused UI.

■ Key Features

【Deck Building】
- Supports the 10 major formats: Standard, Pioneer, Modern, Legacy, Vintage, Commander, Pauper, Alchemy, Historic, and Timeless
- Manage cards across 4 slots: Mainboard / Sideboard / Commander / Wishlist
- Switch between alternate printings of the same card with a single tap
- Full support for double-faced and split-face cards (Transform / MDFC / Flip / Adventure / Meld / Battle)

【Card Search】
- Filter by card name, set, mana cost, color, oracle text, and rarity
- Search by either Japanese or English card name
- View all alternate printings from the card detail screen

【Import / Export】
- Import deck lists from clipboard in MTG Arena / MTGO text format
- For Commander format, cards listed under "Sideboard" are automatically routed to the Commander slot
- A deck thumbnail is automatically set on import
- Export via clipboard copy with a confirmation dialog

【Deck Visual】
- View all cards in your deck at a glance
- In Commander format, commander cards are highlighted with a gold frame
- Save as PNG / share via photo library and the system share sheet

【Solitaire (Goldfishing)】
- 7-card opening hand with London Mulligan
- Full zone simulation: Library / Hand / Battlefield (Lands & Others) / Graveyard / Exile
- Drag-and-drop cards freely between zones
- Tap / untap battlefield cards (with a 90-degree rotation animation)
- Turn tracking with automatic untap at the start of each turn
- Mana pool tracking (W/U/B/R/G + Colorless)
 - Tap a land to auto-generate mana; multicolor lands prompt color selection
 - Mana is automatically consumed when casting spells (moving cards from hand to battlefield or graveyard)
- Library operations: Draw (1–7), Mill (1–7), Exile (1–7), Scry, Search Library, Peek Top, Shuffle
- View Graveyard and Exile contents in a full-card modal

【Other】
- Switch between Japanese and English UI
- Card data is fetched and kept up to date automatically via Scryfall

■ Monetization

- Free plan: Up to 5 decks (watch a rewarded video ad to earn +1 deck slot)
- MTG Crafter Pro (monthly subscription, ¥400 / month or local equivalent): Unlimited decks, no ads

games.description:
BetKing is a volleyball knowledge game built around quick true or false decisions. Each session shows a short statement about the sport and you decide whether it is correct by tapping TRUE or FALSE. BetKing keeps sessions lively whether you play one round or several in a row.

When you open BetKing, you pick Easy, Medium, or Hard to match how confident you feel today. Easy mode focuses on widely known basics such as court size, Olympic history, and familiar rules many fans already recognize. Medium mode stretches your memory with famous players, national teams, and college competition facts that reward regular viewing. Hard mode asks sharper questions about professional tours, precise rule wording, and memorable tournament moments that challenge attentive supporters. You can switch levels anytime from the home screen.

During play, BetKing displays your score, a countdown timer, and the active difficulty label in a clear top bar. A progress line explains how many statements you answered and how many remain in the current round. The center card presents one volleyball fact at a time so you can read carefully before choosing. Correct answers add points and may build a combo streak when you stay accurate across several statements in a row without a mistake. An on screen combo message celebrates steady focus. Wrong answers reset the streak, yet you keep playing until you finish the full set or the timer reaches zero.

BetKing draws questions from pools covering indoor volleyball, beach volleyball, Olympic medals, international federation rules, legendary athletes, and national programs from many countries. Statements can refer to team sizes, set formats, libero roles, blocking, net play, and iconic partnerships fans still discuss. Each round shuffles its lineup so returning players still encounter variety even when they remember a few facts from earlier visits.

When a round ends, BetKing summarizes final score, correct count, wrong count, best combo, how many statements you answered, and your personal best for the chosen difficulty. Tap Play Again to return to the level chooser and begin another run immediately.

BetKing is designed for one handed phone use with large TRUE and FALSE buttons and instant color feedback after each tap so you always know whether your choice matched the fact. Casual fans learning the sport and experienced viewers preparing for a match both get a friendly way to test recall.

If time expires before you finish every statement, the session ends with Time Up and your stats still appear on the results panel. If you answer the entire set before the clock stops, you see Round Complete instead. Either way the breakdown of correct and wrong responses helps you notice topics worth reviewing.

Bring curiosity about serves, sets, spikes, digs, and gold medal stories into each run and see how long you can keep an accurate streak alive. The blend of timed pace, combo rewards, and changing depth turns spare minutes into a compact volleyball facts challenge you can restart anytime. BetKing is ready when you are. Open BetKing, select your level, and enjoy learning through play. BetKing is a fast volleyball true or false quiz with three difficulty levels.

Tommie's garden — where you smash your fractions, grow your daisies.

Want to crush fractions? Slide a tile up — BAM!, it adds. Slide one down — BOOM!, it subtracts. Hit a whole number, and a fresh daisy explodes into your patch. Ten daisies. Twelve rounds. Just you, a flower-fraction, and three tiles asking: which combo lands on 1? One mission: bloom them all.

The game
Tap. Slide. Repeat. The big flower in the centre shows a fraction. Three tiles below it show three more. Add them. Subtract them. Slide them in the right order and the centre hits 6/6, 12/12, and maybe, if you are good, 16/16 — and a new daisy joins your trophy row.
Miss an obvious one? It’s bad — a ladybird flies off. Lose all your ladybirds, and the patch shrivels away. Stakes you can actually feel!

What you get
• One full patch: twelve rounds of escalating bite — denominators 6, 8, 10, 12, then 16. Each round throws a different tile pool at you. • Ten daisies to grow, each one a small detonation of colour when it pops into bloom. • Ladybirds that watch your patch and react to your decisions. • Tap the centre flower to simplify the fraction. Tap a tile for a hint. • A nursery view of every daisy you’ve grown. • A stopwatch with best-time tracking for players who like to chase a personal record — easily ignored if you don’t.

Why it works
Fractions stop being a rule when you can do them with Tommie. Adding 1/3 and 1/6 isn’t a homework problem any more — it’s the move that lands the daisy. Reducing 4/6 to 2/3 is one tap. By the time you’ve grown your garden of daisies, the maths has taught itself.

Built for ages 7+. Loved by grown‑ups who didn’t expect to get hooked.

Done with Lite?
The full Tommie 10 has nine patches, multiple variations, and a final dial-integer puzzle level for players who want a real fight. The upgrade link lives quietly in Settings. Lite is a complete game on its own — finish it on its own terms.

Now go smash some fractions...

games.name: Fortune Teller
games.description:
Welcome to Fortune Teller Fast Pump. This is a game of quick reflexes and precision. The main goal is to pump the balloon to a significant size without causing it to pop.

Gameplay process and core actions:
A typical game session involves two dynamic actions based on a set timer. First comes the Pump stage. While the timer is running you must repeatedly and rapidly tap the designated area on the screen to inflate the balloon and increase your score. Following this is the STOP action. As soon as the STOP signal is displayed, you must immediately stop all tapping. Any additional taps performed after this signal will cause the balloon to pop.

Game structure and feedback:
The game features two functional screens to guide you through your session. The round screen provides all necessary real time information. It shows the game title, the active timer, your current score, the pump control area and the overall status of the round. The results screen appears after the game concludes. This dashboard reveals your session outcome such as whether you landed safely or experienced a burst. You can also view the total points collected and the safe landing score based on the balloon size achieved during pumping. Only a session with no extra taps qualifies for a safe landing summary.

Additional rules and tips:
You start with zero hearts and a fixed countdown for pumping. Tapping the balloon during the timer phase prioritization raises your score. Extra taps during the STOP signal reduce your chances of a safe landing. Following a successful round your final score can be reviewed alongside your previously saved local best safe landing score. The results screen offers options to play again or return to the main menu. Fortune Teller Fast Pump emphasizes accurate timing as a safer approach than risking extra taps. Practice managing your rhythm without gambling on the STOP signal as a safe approach to a better summary. Inflate the balloon as fast as possible by tapping but stop before it pops.

games.name: Soccards: Soccer Card Game
games.description:
Football, played with cards.

Pick a formation. Choose a style. Play your cards. Every match is a full 90 virtual minutes — and it's over in 6 to 8.

Soccards turns the tactical beauty of soccer into a fast, turn-based card game. Your style shapes your hand. Your opponent's style shapes theirs. Each round you both play cards face-down and reveal at the same time — who keeps possession, who advances a zone, who takes the shot, who scores.

YOUR TACTICS, YOUR MATCH

Before kick-off, pick your loadout:
• 6 formations — 4-4-2, 4-3-3, 5-3-2, 3-5-2, 4-5-1, 3-4-3 — each with its own balance of defence, midfield, and attack
• 6 tactical styles — tiki-taka, counter-attack, gegenpressing, route-one, all-out-attack, or classic balanced
• 3 tempos — Normal, Fast, or Ultra for end-to-end chaos

Then play the match. Three zones: your defence, the midfield, their goal. Win rounds to advance the ball. Reach the attack zone in possession — and shoot.

CARDS THAT FEEL LIKE FOOTBALL

Attack cards are the moves you already know: Through Ball, Wide Play, Build-up, Long Shot, Header, Shot. Defence cards are the counters: Low Block, Man Marking, Pressing, Quick Counter, Tackle, Gegenpress, High Press. Support cards let you shift tempo or pack extra intent into a key moment. Event cards bring the drama: call for a VAR check on that goal, swap formations at half-time, waste a minute in the corner flag.

TACTICS OVER GRIND

No gacha. No booster packs. No collection to grind out. Your style picks your deck for you — what matters is how you read the match and when you play the card you've got. Every style plays differently. Every match is a different story.

ARCADE FOOTBALL FEEL

Matches flow like real games — build from the back, progress through midfield, shoot on target — just a little more generous. Expect bangers, own goals, late equalisers, screaming keepers. 1-1, 2-1 and 3-2 are your most common scorelines.

WHAT'S INSIDE

• Quick Game for a one-tap match, or Single Match to build your matchup from scratch
• Live, localised commentary on every pass, tackle, shot and goal
• Full tutorial to learn the flow before your first real match
• Half-time break, injury time, and the full-time whistle, just like the real thing
• Cinematic action zoom on the big moments — toggle on for thrills, off for speed
• Weather flavour that sets the scene — play through rain, wind, sun, or fog
• Playable in English and Italian
• Works offline, anywhere, any time

PLAY ANYWHERE

Single-player vs AI. No logins, no accounts, no sign-up. Short enough for a coffee break, deep enough for a rainy Sunday. Every card is a move. Every match is a story. Football, played with cards.

İKİ FARKLI OYUN MODU
Klasik Mod: Seviye atlama keyfini yaşamak ister misin? Klasik modda her 1500 puan bir seviye kazanırsın. Oyunun başında kolay şekillerle başlarsın, seviye arttıkça şekiller daha karmaşık ve zorlu hale gelir. 700'e kadar seviye atlayabilir, her beş seviyede yeni bir bina ile şehrini büyütebilirsin. Şehir ekranında topladığın binaları görüntüleyebilir ve ilerlemenin tadını çıkarabilirsin.
Skor Modu: Rekor kırmaktan hoşlanıyorsan, Skor modu tam sana göre! Bu modda sınırsız şekil havuzu seni bekliyor. Tüm şekiller açık, stratejini kendin belirle. Yüksek skora ulaşmaya çalışırken aynı zamanda kombolarla ekstra puanlar kazan. Skor modunda limit senin hayal gücün!
ÖZEL BLOK ve MEKANIKLER
Bombalı Blok: Seviye 10'dan sonra karşına çıkan bu güçlü blok, yerleştirildiği yerde 3x3'lük bir alandaki tüm hücreleri yok eder. Üstelik bombalar buzlu hücreleri de kırarak önündeki engelleri temizler. Stratejik kullanımı oyunun gidişatını tamamen değiştirebilir.
Buzlu Hücreler: Grid üzerinde ansizen ortaya çıkan buzlu hücreler, iki vuruşta kırılır. İlk vuruşta buz çatlar ve ICE2 haline gelir, ikinci vuruşta ise tamamen kırılır. Bombalar bu engelleri tek seferde aşabilir. Buzlu hücreler, oyununa ekstra bir strateji katmanı ekler.

CAN SİSTEMİ VE DEVAM ETME
Üç can hakkın var. Tüm blokları yerleştiremediğinde ve grid dolu kaldığında bir canını kaybedersin. Canların tükendiğinde ise oyun biter. Ama endişelenme! 100 coin karşılığında oyununa devam edebilirsin. Ayrıca 150 coin ödeyerek kaybettiğin canları geri alabilirsin. Canların tamamsa ve oyundan çıkmak istersen, ilerlemen otomatik olarak kaydedilir.
ÖDÜLLER VE İLERLEME

Game Rules:

The game is played on an 8x8 grid. Each player has 12 checkers placed on the dark squares of the first three rows. Checkers move one square diagonally forward only.

Capturing is mandatory: if a player can capture an opponent's piece, they must do so.

A capture is made by jumping over an adjacent opponent's piece to an empty square behind it.
Multiple captures are allowed: a piece that captures can continue to capture in the same turn if other captures are possible.
When a piece reaches the last rank of the opponent's base, it is promoted to Queen (King) and its turn ends immediately.
The Queen moves diagonally in any direction an unlimited number of empty squares.
The Queen captures by jumping over an opponent's piece in any diagonal direction and can land on any empty square beyond the captured piece.
A player loses when they have no more pieces or when no legal move is possible.

The game is a draw if neither player can force a win.

Features:

3 difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, and Hard
Local 2-player mode
Interface in 3 languages: French, English, and Arabic
Immersive background music and sound effects
Artistic Moroccan zellige tile design
Victory celebration with fireworks

Animales, comida, películas, series, famosos, música, deportes, superhéroes, terror, navidad, videojuegos, arte, literatura, partes del cuerpo, k-pop, astrología, y muchas más. Algunas categorías son temáticas: magia, galaxias lejanas, reinos de fantasía, criaturas coleccionables… si conocés el género, las vas a reconocer.

Más de 5000 palabras en total. Difícil que se te repitan en una noche.

Cinco idiomas
Español, inglés, portugués, francés e italiano. Cambiás de idioma desde el menú sin reiniciar la app. También sirve para practicar vocabulario en otro idioma sin que sea aburrido.

Sin compras obligatorias
La mayoría de las categorías están desbloqueadas desde el inicio. Las temáticas se desbloquean mirando un video corto. No hay paywall, no hay suscripción.

Funciona sin internet
Una vez que la descargás, podés jugar en cualquier lado: en el auto, en la playa, en una previa donde no hay wifi.

Pensado para
Cumpleaños, previas, sobremesas largas, viajes en auto, asados, despedidas, o cualquier momento en que cinco personas estén juntas y mirando el celular en silencio. (Resuélvanlo.)

Tres consejos para que la pases mejor
- Junten al menos tres personas. Solo no se puede.
- Lean las pistas en voz alta, sin actuar. Es más fácil para todos.
- Cuando alguien acierta, festejen fuerte. La energía del grupo es la mitad del juego.

Descargalo, ponételo en la frente, y empezá a jugar.

games.name: Foil Fever
games.description:
FOIL FEVER
Catch the Flow. Master the Fever.

Foil Fever is a retro-arcade side-scroller that tests your rhythm, timing, and momentum. Built on an addictive physics-based core, you’ll glide through beautiful parallax environments, chasing the perfect run and the ultimate high score.

The mechanics are simple to learn but punishing to master. Your objective is continuous motion. Time your drops and climbs to the shape of the water to build your Foil Flow. Chain together perfect pumps to unlock combo bonuses, maximize your speed, and trigger the ultimate flow state: Foil Fever.

But the water doesn't forgive. The further you ride, the heavier the drag becomes. Your stamina will drain, and the elements will try to pull you off the foil. The only way to survive the mounting exhaustion? Stay in the Flow. Lose your rhythm, and your run is dead in the water.

CHOOSE YOUR FOIL
Master three distinct setups, each demanding a different playstyle to dominate the leaderboards (with more gear and customizations dropping soon):

The Shovel: High lift and forgiving. Perfect for learning the water and finding your rhythm.

The Surf: The balanced all-rounder. Built for smooth lines and consistent combo chaining.

The Blade: High speed, high risk. Requires flawless pumping but yields the highest scoring potential for those who can tame it.

RIDE THE ENVIRONMENTS
Drop into two distinct, infinitely scrolling parallax zones:

The Cape: Massive ocean swells, rolling waves, and unpredictable intervals.

The River: Tighter spacing, relentless currents, and rapid-fire pumping.

And more coming?

FEATURES

Momentum-Based Gameplay: Pump the downslope, glide the upslope. Master the physics of the perfect ride.

Combo System: Hit perfect pumps consecutively to build your multiplier and trigger Foil Fever.

Survival Mechanics: Fight the escalating drag. Maintain your flow to stay above the surface.

Retro Arcade Aesthetic: Crisp parallax scrolling with a nostalgic, high-contrast visual style.

Pure High-Score Chasing: No saves, no checkpoints. Just your skill, your foil, and the top of the leaderboard.

Can you catch the Fever? A retro foiling arcade game

ONE HOST PAYS, EVERYONE ELSE JOINS FREE

INSPIRED BY THE BEST

If you love Sudoku, chess puzzles, Nonograms, or LinkedIn Queens - Queendom is your next obsession. Same logical satisfaction, fresh new challenge.

Queendom is completely free. Watch optional short videos to earn hints, extra lives, or skip a tricky level. No paywalls, no premium locks.

Earshot is an ear-training game that doesn't lecture you about ear training.

You play a detective working thirteen cases across a city of musical conmen. Each case is a puzzle box: a chord, a melody, a fragment you have to identify by ear. Solve it and you close the file. Miss it and the suspect stays at large.

Three puzzle modes:

- Pitch Sort. Tap cells in pitch order, lowest to highest. Sounds simple. It isn't.
- Tone Lock. Spin dials until each one matches the note you heard. The dials don't tell you when you're right.
- Frequency Stack. Drag tokens between slots until the stack is in ascending order. Audition tokens by tapping. Decide what's higher.

Districts ramp from triads in the cellar to dense voicings on the top floor. Skill focus shifts as you go: diatonic shapes, bass intervals, cluster discrimination, chromatic resolution. The difficulty curve is built around what you would actually struggle with, not what is easy to grade.

What Earshot doesn't do:

- No ads.
- No in-app purchases.
- No account, no login, no tracking.
- No daily streak guilt trip.
- No tutorial. The game teaches itself by being honest about what you got wrong.

Single-player. Offline. Your progress lives on your device.

Universal Purchase: works on iPhone and iPad with one buy. Best with headphones. Optional, but you will hear the difference. Thirteen districts, thirteen suspects, three puzzle modes. No tutorial. The game teaches itself by being honest about what you got wrong. Heist game for your ears

The goal is to assemble all sequences from King to Ace of a single suit and move them to the Home; the number of completed sequences depends on the selected mode (Spider/Spiderette).

games.name: Oh Hell Scorekeeper
games.description:
Oh Hell Scorekeeper is the ultimate companion app for the classic card game "Oh Hell". Designed specifically for iPhone and iPad, this clean, modern app automates all score calculations, prevents math mistakes, and tracks detailed player statistics for you to share with your playing partners.

KEY FEATURES:

• FAST & FLEXIBLE GAME SETUP
Quickly add players to your roster, drag-and-drop to match the seating order at your table, and select the starting dealer. Supports 2 to 10 players.

• TWO-PHASE SCORING WITH VALIDATION
Enter bids in Phase 1, then tricks in Phase 2. The app automatically calculates scores according to standard Oh Hell rules: 10 points for a successful bid plus the bid amount, or negative points equal to the difference if you miss.

• AUTOMATIC RULE ENFORCEMENT
Never argue over incorrect bids or tricks again! The app enforces the game’s core rules:
- The "Hook" Rule: The sum of all bids in a round cannot equal the number of cards dealt (ensuring someone always misses).
- Trick Validation: The total number of tricks won must exactly equal the number of cards dealt in the round.

• REAL-TIME SCORE PREVIEWS
See potential scores update in real time as you type trick counts, showing exactly who is in the lead and how many points they stand to gain or lose.

• INTERACTIVE SCORECARD WITH CORRECTIONS
Need to fix a mistake from three rounds ago? Open the detailed scorecard, tap any previous round, and correct the bids or tricks. The app will instantly recalculate all subsequent round scores and updates.

• PERSISTENT GAMES & AUTO-SAVE
Life happens! If you close the app or take a call, your game is automatically saved. Resume any active session from the main menu.

• IN-DEPTH PLAYER STATISTICS & BADGES
Track your group's performance over time with detailed metrics:
- Win/Loss Ratio
- Bidding accuracy and most common bid amounts
- The "Oh Hell" Multiplier (dealer vs. non-dealer success rate)
- Fun Achievements & Badges: "8-Trick Sweep" (winning all tricks in an 8-card round), "The 69 Club" (finishing on exactly 69 points), and "Losing Big" (losing 3+ points in a single round).

• PRIVACY-FIRST & OFFLINE-READY
Oh Hell Scorekeeper does not collect, transmit, or share any personal data. All player profiles, games, and statistics are stored securely on your device. Play anywhere—no internet connection required!

Whether you call it Oh Hell, Oh Pshaw, Blackout, Bust, or Up and Down the River, this scorekeeper makes running your game night effortless so you can focus on playing. Effortlessly track scores, bids, and tricks for the card game Oh Hell. Includes automated rules, live score updates, and detailed player stats. Card Game Scoring & Tracking

games.name: Tile Break Mahjong
games.description:
Tile Break is a polished, modern take on Mahjong solitaire — built from scratch in Swift for iPhone and iPad, hand-tuned to feel great on every device.
Tap two matching free tiles to remove them, build a combo for a multiplier, and clear the board before time runs the score down. No ads. No tracking. No required sign-in. Plays in airplane mode.
— ALWAYS SOLVABLE —
Every board is generated by simulating a full play-through first and then dealing the tiles in the resulting order. The random-shuffle deal that locks you out two minutes in? That's never happening here. Even mid-game shuffles re-roll into a solvable layout.
— SEVEN LAYOUTS —
Garden, Pyramid, Turtle, Cross, Diamond, Tower, and Bricks. Each one is the full 144-tile set, tuned to read clearly on portrait phones and scale up to iPad portrait or landscape.
— SIX THEMES —
Ivory, Jade, Midnight, Cherry, Lantern, and Cyber. Swap any of them live from Settings without losing your in-progress game.
— FOUR TILE FACE SETS —
Classic Mahjong (drawn procedurally so they're crisp at any size), Icons (modern SF Symbols), Garden (nature symbols), and Animals (full-color emoji). Mix and match with any theme.
— TWO RULE VARIANTS —
American (any flower matches any flower, any season matches any season — the modern western convention) and Strict (every tile needs an exact identity match, with flowers and seasons dropped from the pool entirely so every tile has a partner).
— PROCEDURAL MUSIC —
Each theme ships with its own non-repetitive music engine running on AVAudio's sample-accurate scheduler. Ivory is plucky, Midnight is brooding, Cyber leans synthwave. Tap a theme and the music switches instantly. Respects your silent switch.
— SCORING THAT REWARDS SKILL —
Combo streaks multiply your score up to 5×. A misaimed tap or a hint breaks the streak. Fast clears post serious scores. Slow ones still post fine — but you'll see exactly what each hint, undo, and shuffle cost you on the end screen.
— GAME CENTER —
Three global leaderboards: best single-game score, fastest clear, and longest combo. The end-of-game screen loads your personal record next to every stat and highlights a new best in gold — there's no guessing whether you crushed it. Send a real native challenge to a friend after a win and they'll get an in-game banner with the score to beat.
— BUILT CLEAN —
Hand-built in SwiftUI and SpriteKit with zero third-party SDKs, zero analytics, zero ads, and zero tracking. The classic Mahjong tile faces are drawn procedurally in CoreGraphics so they're sharp at every tile size. The app icon is procedural too, generated by a Swift script. Swift 6 strict concurrency. Light on battery, fast on every device.
A one-time purchase. No microtransactions, no subscriptions, no surprises.
Match. Combo. Clear.

games.description:
Welcome to Chance Quest. This application features a quick timing challenge where you must stop a growing circle at the perfect moment. Your primary goal is to match the inner circle to the target outline as closely as possible.

The gameplay is straightforward and focuses on your precision. You will see a target outline circle in the center of the screen. An inner blue circle automatically grows and shrinks at a steady pace. You need to tap anywhere on the game screen exactly when the inner circle matches the outline.

Scoring and accuracy:
Your performance is evaluated based on how well you align the edges of the two circles. After each attempt your result is shown as an accuracy percentage and a score. The closer the match, the higher your accuracy and final score will be. For example, a well-timed tap might result in 72% accuracy and a score of 720.

Tips for success:
To achieve better results you should focus entirely on the edge alignment. A single well-timed tap is all you need to complete the challenge. You can monitor your current score and the elapsed time at the top of the screen during the session.

Review and replay:
Once you finish an attempt, the results screen displays your summary. From there you can choose to use the Play again button to try and improve your previous record or use the Back to menu button to return to the start screen. Chance Quest offers a simple way to practice your concentration and fine motor skills in a relaxing environment. Test your timing and accuracy in the Chance Quest circle matching challenge.

Just a finite collection of handcrafted anagram puzzles — the same kind you've seen in newspapers and crossword books for decades — drawn from a list of common English words with real anagram siblings.
The background drifts slowly behind your letters. The sounds are soft. The feedback is gentle. The timer gives you enough room to think. It's a word game designed for actual humans who like words.

Features:

- Clean, accessible design tuned for iPhone and iPad

- One-handed play, portrait-only on iPhone, both orientations on iPad

Made by a word game fan: 
Scrambly is built by Peter, the creator of the Apptato YouTube channel — home to thousands of word puzzle videos watched by people who genuinely love unscrambling letters. This app is the version of a word game he wanted to play himself. No aggressive monetization. No pay-to-win. No gimmicks.
Just you, the letters, and the words you can find in them.

A note on ads:
Scrambly is free and supported by occasional ads between rounds. We never interrupt gameplay, never show ads during a puzzle, and cap the ad frequency so you're not bombarded. If you play a short round, you probably won't see an ad at all.

Find us on YouTube! Check out Apptato on YouTube for daily scrambled word puzzle videos, anagram challenges, and more: youtube.com/@apptato A calm, classic anagram game. games.name: Singapore Life Simulator
games.description:
Live a Singapore life, one swipe at a time.

You're born in a heartland HDB in 1995. Or 2003. Or 1988. Pa was a quiet
Lianhe Zaobao reader. Mum was a tiger parent. Or maybe Pa drove a taxi
and Mum stretched a CDC voucher every month.

Either way — here you are.

Swipe right to take the kopi. Swipe left to refuse. Swipe left to take
the GEP test, swipe right to refuse.

Each card moves you forward through PSLE results day, ORD or skipping
it, your first job, your first heartbreak, the small CNY dinners and the
big ones, until one day the cards run out and you get an eulogy.

That's the game.

— FOUR METERS TRACK YOUR LIFE —
Wealth. Happiness. Family. Reputation. Push any one to the extreme and
it kills you in a different way: the cancelled civil servant, the
smothered patriarch, the CPIB casualty, the smiling delusion. There's
no winning. Only the life you choose to lead.

— EVERY LIFE IS DIFFERENT —
Race, family background, and birth year are randomly assigned at the
start. Hawker mum or condo mum? Hokkien Ah Ma or Tamil Paati? Born in
1985 or 2005? Story arcs branch quietly. The same swipe doesn't always
lead to the same outcome.

— ELEVEN ENDINGS —
A chalkboard menu for the beloved hawker. The Twitter cancel-feed of a
fallen influencer. The sepia frame of an HDB Saint. A banker's quiet
statement. A CPIB folder. A kopitiam for the Heartland Hero. A
Bloomberg terminal for the Disillusioned Banker. A 2am kitchen for the
Caregiver Burnt Out. A washed-pastel snapshot for the Beautiful
Delusion. A green felt table for the Gambler. A short obituary in
serif. Each ending fits the life you led.

— 472 MOMENTS —
Ah Ma's last ang bao. PSLE results day. The SAF11B you waved on ORD
day. CNY reunion dinner with the auntie who never stops asking when
you're getting married. NDP funpacks. F1 night. Hari Raya open house.
Deepavali lights at Little India. The void deck wake.

— THINGS YOU CARRIED —
Pa's old Seiko. Ah Ma's last ang bao. Nenek's last duit raya. Paati's
Deepavali packet. The wedding ring. The grandchild's first drawing.
Each life accumulates heirlooms — they show up in your eulogy as the
things you took with you.

games.name: SuperBrain - Codebreaker
games.description:
Knacke den Code. Jeden Tag.

SuperBrain ist ein modernes Logikrätsel im Geist eines Mastermind-Klassikers. Ein verdeckter Code aus vier farbigen Steinen, zehn Versuche, präzise Hinweise nach jedem Zug. Kein Glück, kein Bling, keine Werbung – nur Schritt für Schritt zur richtigen Lösung.

Das Spiel ist für die fünf Minuten zwischen Kaffee und Meeting. Für den Bus. Fürs Warten in der Schlange. Statt ziellos zu scrollen, denkst du. Jeden Tag ein bisschen schärfer.

So funktioniert es

Du errätst eine geheime Farbkombination. Nach jedem Versuch siehst du Hinweise. Ein schwarzer Punkt heißt: eine Farbe steht an der richtigen Stelle. Ein weißer Punkt heißt: die Farbe gehört zwar in den Code, aber nicht an diese Position. Aus diesen Hinweisen schließt du, was wahr sein muss – und was sicher nicht.

Die Schwierigkeit Leicht mit fünf Farben spielst du kostenlos, so oft du willst. Mittel (sechs Farben) und Schwer (sieben Farben, ein Stein mehr) gehören zu SuperBrain Premium – mehr dazu weiter unten.

Der Daily Code

Einmal pro Tag derselbe Code, weltweit identisch, nur für 24 Stunden lösbar. Wer ihn knackt, baut eine Serie auf. Wer einen Tag vergisst, verbraucht automatisch einen Streak Freeze – also kein "alles verloren, weil einmal vergessen". Der Daily Code ist immer kostenlos.

Was deinen Fortschritt sichtbar macht

• Level- und XP-System für jeden gelösten Code
• Bestzeit, Versuchsverteilung und eine 90-Tage-Heatmap deiner Spielhistorie
• Identitätstitel von Lehrling bis Großmeister
• Wochen-Challenge mit XP-Bonus, die jeden Montag wechselt

Cosmetics, die du verdienst

Fünf Peg-Stile lassen sich durch Spielen freischalten: Klassisch, Ring, Konzentrisch, Dawn, Geprägt. Keine Loot-Boxen. Kein Bezahlen. Du sammelst sie durch Level, Streaks und Achievements.

SuperBrain Premium

Premium ist eine optionale Erweiterung über In-App-Kauf. Drei Pläne stehen zur Wahl: monatlich, jährlich oder einmalig (Lifetime). Was damit dazukommt:

• Schwierigkeit Mittel: sechs Farben, vier Stellen
• Schwierigkeit Schwer: sieben Farben, fünf Stellen
• Vollständige Entwicklungsstatistik mit Versuchen, Zeit, Lösungsquote und Trend pro Schwierigkeit

Mehr gibt es nicht zu kaufen. Daily Code, Schwierigkeit Leicht, Cosmetics, Streak, Wochen-Challenge und der Großteil der App bleiben dauerhaft kostenlos.

Privatsphäre ohne Sternchen

Keine Werbung. Kein Cross-App-Tracking. Kein Account-Zwang. Dein Fortschritt liegt auf deinem Gerät. Wenn du iCloud nutzt, synchronisiert sich der Stand zwischen iPhone und iPad – verschlüsselt, an deine Apple-ID gebunden.

Eine Erinnerung, falls du sie willst

Du kannst dir am Abend einen kurzen Hinweis schicken lassen, dass die heutige Daily noch offen ist. Zeit wählbar. Jederzeit aus. Sonst lassen wir dich in Ruhe.

Design und Zugänglichkeit

Schlicht, warm, ohne visuellen Lärm. Geist und Instrument Serif als Schriften. Inspiriert von NYT Games, Linear und Duolingo. Mit Farbblind-Modus, haptischem Feedback und drei Themes: Hell, Dunkel und Klassisch.

خمس طرق لعب مختلفة:

خمّن
لاعيب غامض وعندك تلميحات. اكشفهم واحد واحد لحد ما تعرف هو مين. كل تلميح هيقللك النقط. تقدر تعرفه من غير ما تكشف كله؟

التشكيلة
ماتش بتشكيلته الكاملة قدامك، بس الأسامي مخفية. حط كل لاعيب في مكانه الصح وإنت تحت ضغط الوقت. مود التحدي بين اتنين هيقلب الجلسة لمعركة بالنوبة. أول واحد يكمّل الإحدعشر يكسب.

مسيرة
سيرة لاعيب من غير اسم. الأندية اللي لعب فيها، السنين، البلاد. عندك تلات محاولات تعرفه قبل ما يطلع منك.

مسلسل
لعبة جماعية على موبايل واحد. فريقك يوصفلك اللاعيب من غير ما يقول اسمه ولا اسم ناديه، وإنت تخمّن. أكتر فريق ياخد لاعيبة في الوقت يكسب. مثالية للقعدات والسحبيات.

الملاعب
صورة ملعب قدامك. اعرفه من السعة، البلد، أو النادي اللي بيلعب فيه. كل تلميح بيكلفك من النقط، فاحسبها صح.

مميزات تانية:

التحدي اليومي: لاعيب جديد كل يوم. سيب بصمتك في الليدر بورد.
شير مع صحابك: ابعت لينك التحدي وخلي صاحبك يلعب نفس الجلسة ويشوف هو أحسن منك ولا إنت.
ليدر بورد: شوف ترتيبك بين عشاق الكورة في مصر والوطن العربي.
محتوى عربي أصيل: أسامي اللاعيبة والأندية والمسابقات بالعربي زي ما الجمهور بيقولها.
بدون تعقيد: تصميم خفيف وسريع، يشتغل حتى على شبكات ضعيفة.

ليه المدرّج؟

مش مجرد كويز عشوائي. كل سؤال متظبط بإيد ناس بتفهم في الكورة. من الدوري الإنجليزي والإسباني، للدوري المصري والأفريقي، للمنتخبات والكأس العالم. لو كنت بتتفرج على الكورة من زمان أو من جيل ميسي ورونالدو، هتلاقي اللي يتحداك.

نزّل دلوقتي وابدأ تثبت إنك مدرّج حقيقي.

Fast to start. A party is live in under ten seconds.

Easy to teach. The whole game is one rule. Untangle the coil before anyone else does, and sabotage the player who is about to beat you.

Built for groups. Bring in your roommates, your cousins, your whole study group. Everyone races at once on their own screen, against the same puzzle.

Calm to look at. Warm colors, gentle motion, zero flashing ads, zero pop ups begging you to rate.

Respectful of your phone. Tiny download. Light on battery. No tracking ad networks. No data sold to anyone.

HOW A ROUND WORKS

1. Host taps Create Party. A six character code appears.
2. Everyone else taps Join and enters the code, or scans the QR.
3. The same puzzle drops on every device.
4. Race. Untangle. Shuffle your rivals. Beat the room.
5. Scoreboard updates live. Next round starts when the host is ready.

GOOD FOR

Family game nights. Friend hangouts. Couples on the couch. Classrooms. Office lunches. Bachelor and bachelorette parties. Long flights with cousins. Dorm rooms at midnight. Anywhere a group has phones and five minutes to spare.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO

Ask for your email. Ask for your name. Send you push notifications you did not sign up for. Show ads between rounds. Lock content behind a subscription. Track you across other apps. Sell your data.

CoilParty does not collect personal information. Gameplay state is synced anonymously so devices in the same party stay in sync. Full policy at https://coilparty.web.app/privacy

games.name: Warrior Fortune
games.description:
Warrior Fortune presents a precision timing challenge where you test your accuracy against a growing target. The main goal of the application is to stop a transparent disc exactly when its edge meets a fixed outline.

How it works:
You will see a calm timing ring on the playing field. A transparent disc grows from the center of this ring. You must tap the screen at the exact moment the edge of the growing disc meets the inner line of the ring. Success depends on tapping not too early and not too late.

session flow:

Each game session consists of five timed pulses played back to back.

Every tap is scored on a scale from 0% to 100% based on how close your stop was to the ideal ring match.

If a pulse finishes before you manage to tap the screen that specific round scores 0%.

After the completion of the fifth pulse you receive your final results.

Results and tracking:
The session results screen displays your average accuracy for the run a combined score and your best average recorded so far. Warrior Fortune automatically tracks your personal best results to help you monitor your performance improvements.

Tips:

Watch the HUD timer during play as it mirrors the remaining stretch time for the current pulse.

Stay relaxed while playing because the ring maintains a steady speed throughout a single session. Warrior Fortune is a precision ring challenge to stop a disc on the outline.

Sudoku · Wordle · daily logic puzzles · nonograms (Picross) · crosswords · Knotwords · Mahjong · Mini Metro · Monument Valley · or simply ten focused minutes a day.

How to play:
The first screen is the reaction test itself. It starts with a random delay while the app shows a Waiting status. Your goal is to wait for the play area to flash green then tap the screen as fast as you can.

Rules of the game:

If you tap too early the round fails and you must tap again to retry the test.

Tapping exactly when the screen turns green records your reaction time in milliseconds.

The second screen displays your results including your last recorded time and your best time ever.

Scoring system:
Reaction time is measured from the exact moment the screen turns green until your tap is registered. A smaller number represents a faster reaction and is considered better. Your best score is always your lowest recorded time.

Tips for success:
Hold your phone steady and focus on the center of the screen to minimize your response time.

Mountain Treasure features a clean interface with a mountain landscape and a treasure chest theme. You can restart the test at any time by selecting Play again or return to the main menu using the on screen buttons. Mountain Treasure is a quick reaction mini game to measure your speed.

games.name: Legend Chess Arena
games.description:
Chess Legends — Play Against History's Greatest Masters

What if you could sit across the board from Paul Morphy, the genius who never lost a serious game? Or feel the relentless pressure of Alekhine's attacking play? Chess Legends brings history's greatest players to life — each one faithfully recreated with their own unique style, strengths, and weaknesses.

PLAY AGAINST LEGENDARY MASTERS
Choose from 16 historical legends, each with a distinct playing style built from their real games and documented strategies:

- Paul Morphy — The romantic attacker who punished passive play
- Alexander Alekhine — Deep calculations and relentless initiative
- José R. Capablanca — Flawless technique and endgame precision
- Emanuel Lasker — Psychological mastery and fighting spirit
- Wilhelm Steinitz — The father of positional chess
- Aron Nimzowitsch — Prophylaxis and hypermodern strategy
- Richard Réti — Flexible piece play and flank openings
- Mikhail Chigorin — Knight lover and combinational genius
- Adolf Anderssen — The Immortal Game creator
- Akiba Rubinstein — The greatest rook endgame player of all time
- Harry Pillsbury — Systematic attack and piece coordination
- Carl Schlechter — Solid, balanced, and almost impossible to beat
- François-André Philidor — "Pawns are the soul of chess"
- Ruy López de Segura — The founding father of opening theory
- And more...

AUTHENTIC STYLE SIMULATION
Each legend doesn't just play good chess — they play *their* chess. Morphy develops pieces at lightning speed and punishes any passive move. Petrosian avoids weaknesses at all costs and neutralises your plans before you form them. Tal sacrifices material for complications, trusting chaos over calculation. The simulation goes deep: opening books built from real historical games, positional preferences, tactical tendencies, and even characteristic error patterns.

THREE DIFFICULTY LEVELS
Not ready to face Capablanca? Start with Beginner, Normal, or Professional opponents to build your skills before challenging the legends.

POST-GAME ANALYSIS
After each game, review every move with engine-powered analysis. See your accuracy rating, identify blunders and brilliant moves, and understand exactly where the game turned.

ELO RATING SYSTEM
Track your progress with a personal Elo rating that updates after every game. Watch yourself grow as you defeat stronger and stronger opponents across history.

HISTORICAL CONTEXT
Each legend comes with their era, playing style, and Elo equivalent — giving you a window into 500 years of chess history, from Ruy López in 16th-century Spain to Alekhine's combinations in the 1930s.

CLEAN, FOCUSED EXPERIENCE
No ads. No distractions. Just you and the board.

Chess Legends is for players who love chess history and want more than a rating number — they want to understand how the game evolved and feel what it was like to face the greatest minds the game has ever produced. Chess Legends — Play against history's greatest chess masters
